metadata.title: Value Physics: Thermodynamic Exergy, Metabolic Labor, and Non-Linear State-Space Dynamics (Release v2.7.0 Computational Replication Package)
metadata.description: Comprehensive computational replication package, simulation engines, high-resolution phase figures, and LaTeX manuscript sources for Value Physics — Division 2: Societal Economics & Macro-Micro Simulation. Accompanies the dual flagship journal submission suite: 'The Physics of Economic Value' (Ecological Economics / ARI-VPE-JRNL-2026-01) and 'Thermodynamic Work-Antiwork State-Space Dynamics' (Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control / ARI-VPE-TH-2026-02). Includes 11 standalone Python simulation engines, 24 unit tests with 100% pass rate, Sraffa-Leontief 5-sector input-output matrices, Unscented Kalman Filter state-space decouplers, and 156-week Stock-Flow Consistent balance sheet models.

creators.name: Hamilton, Jarrod Lyndsay
creators.affiliation: Alethekanon Research Institute — Division 2: Societal Economics & Macro-Micro Simulation, Australia
